kurz: Raw fish cubes in lemon or lime juice turn white and firm within half an hour, as if cooked.
bild_im_kopf: Like egg white in a hot pan, but without the pan: the acid does the work of the heat.
beobachtung: In the juice the fish is white and firm on the outside; in the water it has stayed translucent and soft.
erklaerung: Acid changes the proteins much as heat does: they unfold and link up anew. That is why the fish looks cooked. But acid does not kill germs as reliably as heat.
sicherheit: Only with very fresh fish; for children, for looking at only. Do not eat it if you are unsure how fresh it is.
schritte: Cut the fish into small cubes.
Cover one half with lemon juice and the other with water.
Cover and chill for 30 minutes, then compare.
material: a piece of very fresh white fish
